recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色：積液細胞塊中大多數大型腫瘤細胞呈強的細胞膜與細胞質（部分高基氏體區點狀）陽性，背景小細胞為陰性；PEL 常表現 CD30，但仍須以 HHV8 LANA-1 確認診斷。
features: Strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD30 staining in the majority of large neoplastic cells
Positive cells are large and discohesive, arranged in loose clusters
Small background cells negative, serving as internal negative control
Pale fibrinous background typical of a cell block
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD30 on the effusion cell block shows strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining, with focal Golgi accentuation, in the majority of the large atypical cells. Scattered small background cells are negative. CD30 expression is common in primary effusion lymphoma and supports an activated/plasmablastic phenotype but is not specific. Together with morphology, the findings are supportive of primary effusion lymphoma; diagnosis requires demonstration of HHV8 LANA-1 nuclear positivity and exclusion of other CD30-positive neoplasms.

ddx.vs: ALCL is also strongly CD30+ but expresses T-cell antigens or cytotoxic markers (and ALK in ALK+ ALCL), and is HHV8 negative.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+/PAX5 weak in an inflammatory background, rarely present as isolated effusion, and are HHV8 negative.
Embryonal carcinoma is CD30+ but is cohesive, keratin+, OCT4+ and SALL4+, and CD45 negative.
